subject: Parallelism in Irace and target runner at the same time

messages.author: ce516167250ea3a7
messages.subject: Parallelism in Irace and target runner at the same time
parts:
Hi Irace Team, I am trying to run an algorithm with parallelism in irace and it works very well, however when enabling parallelism in Irace the algorithm begins to crash

scenario <- list(targetRunner = target.runner,
                           trainInstancesDir = path("ds","dset"),
                           digits = 2,
                           maxExperiments = 300,
                           parallel = 4,
                           logFile = "irace.Rdata")

checkIraceScenario(scenario, parameters = parameters)

# Warning occurred when running targetRunner:
1 function calls resulted in an error
Error in socketConnection("localhost", port = port, server = TRUE, blocking = TRUE, : can't open connection
# An error occurred while running targetRunner:
== irace == A child process triggered a fatal error
# targetRunner returned:
NULL
Error: == irace == Check failed.


tuned.confs <- irace(scenario = scenario, parameters = parameters)

Error in socketConnection("localhost", port = port, server = TRUE, lock = TRUE, :
can not open the connection
Error: == irace == A child process triggered a fatal error
In addition: Warning message:
In parallel::mclapply(experiments, exec.target.runner, mc.preschedule = !scenario$loadBalancing, :
7 function calls resulted in an error

it can be fixed?

Regards
JAC

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: Parallelism in Irace and target runner at the same time
parts:
Strange! The parallel stuff works very well in Linux. Could you try the following?

* I see you are running from the R shell. After you get the error above, could you execute "traceback()"  and send me the output?

* Could you try to repeat the same but adding the scenario setting "loadBalancing=FALSE"?

* Could you try to run the following commands in R?

library(parallel)
simplify2array(mclapply(rep(4, 5), rnorm, mc.cores=4))

* After the error, does irace create a file named iracedump or something similar? If so, could you send it to me?

*  After the error, does irace create a file irace.Rdata? If so, could you send it to me?

* Could you also send me the output generated when using parallel=1 instead of parallel=4?

Cheers,

Manuel.
